                                                                (⌜(m.Type' = MsgVoteResp ∧ s.role = PRole.candidate ∨
                                                                        m.Type' = MsgPreVoteResp ∧
                                                                          s.role = PRole.preCandidate) ∧
                                                                      JLost c (recordVote s.votes m.From' !m.Reject')⌝ -∗
                                                                  G s.outbox -∗
                                                                    HookGate s.gh.tr r
                                                                      (NodeEvOf (W64 2) id
                                                                        (becomeFollower
                                                                          { term := s.term, vote := s.vote,
                                                                            lead := s.lead, role := s.role,
                                                                            votes :=
                                                                              recordVote s.votes m.From' !m.Reject',
                                                                            outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn,
                                                                            ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress,
                                                                            log := s.log, logst := s.logst,
                                                                            prvals := s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote,
                                                                            gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt,
                                                                            pci := s.pci, isLearner := s.isLearner,
                                                                            sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq }
                                                                          s.term (W64 0))
                                                                        c)
                                                                      (G' s.outbox)) -∗
                              (▷
                                  ∀ err s' dropped c',
                                    ownRaftPhysCV c' c'.voters r id s' ∗
                                        ⌜CandidateStepResultC c scfg id s m ents sv dropped s' c' cl⌝ ∗
                                          (if dropped = true then
                                              typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrProposalDropped) err DFrac.discard
                                            else ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝) ∗
                                            (⌜m.Type' = MsgApp ∨
                                                    m.Type' = MsgHeartbeat ∨
                                                      (m.Type' = MsgVoteResp ∧ s.role = PRole.candidate ∨
                                                          m.Type' = MsgPreVoteResp ∧ s.role = PRole.preCandidate) ∧
                                                        (JQuorum c (granted (recordVote s.votes m.From' !m.Reject')) ∨
                                                          JLost c (recordVote s.votes m.From' !m.Reject'))⌝ ∗
                                                G' s'.outbox ∨
                                              ⌜¬(m.Type' = MsgApp ∨
                                                      m.Type' = MsgHeartbeat ∨
                                                        (m.Type' = MsgVoteResp ∧ s.role = PRole.candidate ∨
                                                            m.Type' = MsgPreVoteResp ∧ s.role = PRole.preCandidate) ∧
                                                          (JQuorum c (granted (recordVote s.votes m.From' !m.Reject')) ∨
                                                            JLost c (recordVote s.votes m.From' !m.Reject')))⌝ ∗
                                                G s'.outbox) -∗
                                      Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
